changelog:
v3.7.9 — HEVC HDR Now Plays on Older Fire TV Sticks

If you've ever seen "This channel is streaming in HDR which your device can't play" on a Fire TV Stick 4K Lite (AFTSS) — that error is gone. The hardware on those devices actually does decode 10-bit HEVC, the app was just refusing to try.

Verified head-to-head against IPTV Smarters on the same Fire TV Stick 4K Lite hardware: both apps now use the same OMX.MTK hardware HEVC decoder for Bones S01E03 (4-7 Mbps HEVC Main 10 + EAC3 5.1) at full 1.0x playback speed.

• HDR titles like Bones, Cinemax movies in HEVC 10-bit, sports streams in 10-bit HDR, etc., now play on AFTSS / mt8695-class Fire TV Sticks
• No code change for AFTKRT / mt8696 / Shield / 4K Max — those were already working
• If a stream genuinely can't be hardware-decoded on a given device, ExoPlayer's existing decoder fallback chain handles it — no upfront error
